evidence.excerpt: The project developed and validated a structured pre-compliance methodology for predicting radiated and conducted electromagnetic emissions from mixed-signal PCBs before formal certification testing. Work packages covered automated layout rule checking, near-field scan data processing and far-field transformation, and parametric FDTD simulation libraries for common PCB geometries. The methodology was validated on test vehicles designed at the faculty and on prototype boards provided by two partner companies from the Vojvodina electronics manufacturing sector. The project trained two doctoral students and produced seven peer-reviewed publications. An open-source rule-checker tool was released under a permissive licence. The project supported calibration and upgrade of the faculty's near-field scanning bench, including a new motorised Z-axis stage.
